ticket.title: Imbalance on Test rig - DC motor with rotor disk
ticket.evidence: 1x amplitude 6.1x baseline (speed-normalised), harmonics 0.8x, overall vibration 4.9x at 1500 RPM.
ticket.action_taken: Imbalance detected, vibration 4.9x baseline: reducing speed to 74.
ticket.recommended_action: Inspect rotor balance and mounting bolts; rebalance or tighten, then recapture the baseline.
